description: Asked after Titus, and reported Gib on the stair.
name: Alse Pinder

description: Boiled the ink and priced the horn.
name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

description: Remained on the stair and did not speak.
name: Gib

description: Paid twopence, stayed in, and went up to a nameless leaf.
name: William Shakespeare
